title: You Don't Have to Post Every Day

scenes.say: Post every day or disappear, they say. That rule burns owners out.
Even the head of Instagram once suggested a couple of feed posts a week. Not seven.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: You have to post every single day
props.fact: Instagram's head once said a couple of feed posts a week

scenes.say: What matters is showing up every week. In one study of over a hundred thousand accounts, the ones that posted most weeks got about five times the engagement per post.
So post three times a week you can actually keep up. Every week. Agree? Tell me in the comments.

props.name: Roma Tom
props.quote: Three a week you can keep. *Agree?*
